Container.Name: plex-exporter
Container.Overview:
Puts your Plex server's streams, transcodes, bandwidth and library sizes into Prometheus, so you can watch them in Grafana and get alerts.
Shows who is watching what, on which device, and whether it plays directly or is transcoded. Tracks each stream's bandwidth and bitrate, counts the items, length and disk space of each library, and adds host CPU, memory and total bandwidth on a server with Plex Pass. A Grafana dashboard and nine alert rules ship in the project repository. It only reads from Plex and has no web UI of its own.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: plex prometheus grafana metrics exporter monitoring
Container.Requires: Needs a Prometheus-compatible scraper (Prometheus, Grafana Alloy, VictoriaMetrics) pointed at port 9594 and Grafana to show the dashboard. Neither is included. Plex URL: the full URL of your Plex server including scheme and port, for example http://192.0.2.100:32400. Plex Token: the server administrator's token. Plex's guide Finding an authentication token shows where to find it: https://support.plex.tv/articles/204059436-finding-an-authentication-token-x-plex-token/ Host CPU, memory and bandwidth metrics require Plex Pass. Everything else works without it. The metrics endpoint has no login, so keep port 9594 on your LAN.

Config.Name: Plex URL
Config.Description: Full URL of your Plex Media Server including scheme and port, for example http://192.0.2.100:32400

Config.Name: Plex Token
Config.Description: Plex authentication token of the server administrator. Plex's guide: https://support.plex.tv/articles/204059436-finding-an-authentication-token-x-plex-token/

Config.Name: Metrics port
Config.Description: Prometheus metrics at /metrics and health at /api/health

Config.Name: Plex CA certificate path
Config.Description: Only for an https Plex URL with a self-signed or private-CA certificate. The path of the CA PEM file inside the container, with a matching path mapping
